_metadata.description: Optical property evidence cards for villa pipeline C7 material appearance class verification
_metadata.structure: List of optical evidence cards covering alloys and architectural glazing with quotes, sources, and applicability

cards.quoted_source_text: M. R. Querry. Optical constants, Contractor Report CRDC-CR-85034 (1985). 70% Cu, 30% Zn.
cards.publisher: U.S. Army Armament, Munitions and Chemical Command / RefractiveIndex.INFO
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to 70% copper / 30% zinc alpha-brass alloy. Normal-incidence specular reflectance computed via Fresnel equation R = ((n-1)^2 + k^2) / ((n+1)^2 + k^2). Our ASSUMED villa material uses flat scalar rho = 0.62 (villa_render.py:122); Querry demonstrates yellow spectral rise (0.434 blue to 0.887 red) with photopic average ~0.74.

cards.quoted_source_text: Surface finish, also known as surface texture or surface topography, is the nature of a surface as defined by the three characteristics of lay, surface roughness, and waviness.
cards.source_title: Materials and Processes in Manufacturing (9th ed.) / Surface finish
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to commercial satin brushed architectural brass. Typical arithmetic mean roughness Ra is 0.4 to 0.8 um (16 to 32 microinches) produced by belt sanding or scotch-brite brushing. Differs from mirror polished brass (Ra 0.05 to 0.1 um).

cards.quoted_source_text: ASTM D523 Standard test method for specular gloss in 1939. This incorporated a method for measuring gloss at a specular angle of 60°.
cards.source_title: Standard Test Method for Specular Gloss (ASTM D523) / Gloss (optics)
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to semi-gloss / satin metal finishes under ASTM D523 / ISO 2813 60-degree geometry. Measured 10 to 30 GU maps to Principled BSDF microfacet roughness sigma in [0.25, 0.35]. Our ASSUMED villa roughness sigma = 0.30 (villa_render.py:122) falls directly in this measured range.

cards.source_title: Standard Technical Delivery Conditions for Extruded and Drawn Brass Rod (EN 12164 / CW614N / CuZn39Pb3)
cards.publisher: European Committee for Standardization (CEN) / Copper Development Association
cards.applicability_notes: Manufacturer cut sheets for free-machining architectural brass (CW614N / CuZn39Pb3 / UNS C38500) publish mechanical tensile strength, proof strength, elongation, and chemical assay, but do not publish spectrophotometric reflectance. Searches tried: 'CW614N reflectance datasheet', 'CW614N optical properties cut sheet', 'CuZn39Pb3 refractive index reflectance', 'architectural brushed brass reflectance cut sheet'.

cards.quoted_source_text: Pilkington Optilam™ 6,4 is the most widely used thickness for protecting people against risk of accidental injury giving Class 2(B)2 performance to EN 12600.
cards.source_title: Pilkington Optilam™ Product Range & Declarations of Performance
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to 10.8 mm (55.2) clear laminated safety glass (two 5 mm clear float panes with 0.76 mm PVB interlayer) tested to EN 410 and EN 12600 Class 1(B)1 / 2(B)2. Our ASSUMED villa value is tau = 0.85 (villa_render.py:132). The tested clear product transmits 0.89; the assumed 0.85 reflects either conservative dirt allowance or darker interlayer.

cards.source_title: High temperature glass melt property database for process modeling / Soda-lime glass
cards.publisher: American Ceramic Society (Seward & Vascott 2005) / European Standard EN 572-1:2012+A1:2016
cards.page_or_section: Table: Physical properties of soda-lime glasses
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to flat soda-lime glass substrate at 20 °C (nD = 1.520) and harmonised European standard EN 572-1:2012 Clause 5.2 (mean visible n = 1.50). PVB interlayer index is 1.482. Our ASSUMED villa material uses eta = 1.50 (material-basis.md:84), which matches EN 572-1.

cards.quoted_source_text: Pilkington Optiwhite™ is an extra-clear, low-iron float glass; it is practically colourless, and the green cast inherent to other clear glasses is not present.
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to 10 mm monolithic low-iron extra-clear float glass (Pilkington Optiwhite, Guardian UltraClear, Saint-Gobain SGG DIAMANT) tested to EN 410. Our ASSUMED villa value in revit_spec.py:434 is tau = 0.91 (which is valid for 4-6 mm); at 10 mm pane thickness, tested light transmittance is exactly 0.90 (90%).

cards.quoted_source_text: The refractive index and extinction coefficient was extracted for NSG Opti-White (low-Fe) glass from a multi-oscillator model fit to the ellipsometry data, as a function of wavelength, from 300 to 1500 nm
cards.source_title: RF magnetron sputtering of transparent conducting oxides and CdTe/CdS solar cells, PhD Thesis
cards.page_or_section: COMMENTS & DATA tabulated nk, line 202 (0.58728204 um)
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to NSG Pilkington Optiwhite low-iron float glass measured by variable-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry. At He d-line (587.3 nm), n = 1.5056 and extinction coefficient k = 2.77e-7. Our ASSUMED villa material in revit_spec.py:434 uses eta = 1.52; tested Optiwhite is 1.506.

cards.quoted_source_text: CE Marking indicates that a product conforms to a European technical standard identified as a harmonised European Norm (hEN).
cards.source_title: Pilkington CE Marking & Declarations of Performance (EN 572 / EN 410)
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to 4 mm to 6 mm monolithic clear float glass (Pilkington Optifloat Clear, Saint-Gobain Planiclear) to EN 410. Monolithic single-pane transmittance is 0.89 to 0.90, with light reflectance 0.08.

cards.quoted_source_text: Metric Handbook p. 9-8: clear double glazing tau = 0.70, interfaces = 2.
cards.source_title: Metric Handbook: Planning and Design Data
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to standard architectural double glazing unit (DGU, 6 mm float + 16 mm cavity + 6 mm float). Certified total visible light transmittance is 0.70 (70%). Exactly matches active production entry in villa_render.py:130.

cards.source_title: High temperature glass melt property database for process modeling / Soda-lime glass
cards.publisher: American Ceramic Society (Seward & Vascott 2005) / CEN EN 572-1:2012
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to standard soda-lime architectural float glass. Seward & Vascott reports nD = 1.520 at 20 °C; EN 572-1 specifies mean visible n = 1.50. Matches active production entry in villa_render.py:130 (eta = 1.50).

cards.quoted_source_text: Studies of polished metal surfaces and anodised aluminium automotive trim in the 1960s by Tingle, Potter and George led to the standardisation of gloss measurement
cards.source_title: Specifications for the Qualanod Quality Label / Gloss (optics)
cards.publisher: Qualanod / Society of Automotive Engineers / Wikimedia
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to dark bronze architectural anodised aluminium (Qualanod colour C34 / EURAS C34). Colorimetric lightness L* in CIELAB is 34 to 36, giving diffuse photopic reflectance Y = ((L*+16)/116)^3 = 0.080 to 0.093. Perfectly matches active villa material rho = 0.09 (villa_render.py:180).

cards.quoted_source_text: In the paint industry, measurements of the specular gloss are made according to International Standard ISO 2813... This standard is essentially the same as ASTM D523 although differently drafted.
cards.applicability_notes: Applies to satin/matt architectural anodised finishes on aluminium. Specular gloss under 60-degree geometry is 15 to 30 GU per ISO 2813. Maps to microfacet roughness sigma in [0.30, 0.38]. Active production villa material specifies sigma = 0.35 (villa_render.py:180).
